attack_phase: Phase 2 — Privilege Escalation via Forged Delegation Chain

L0.description: lead-agent 以 acting_as: security-auditor 身份委派给 resource-inspector。委派记录无密码学签名，acting_as 字段为自报值，未经任何验证即被接受。

L1.description: resource-inspector 以 acting_as: deployment-verifier 身份委派给 agent-b。范围检查使用 claimed role (acting_as) 而非 assigned role (resource-inspector)，允许越权扩大权限范围。

L2.description: agent-b 以 acting_as: security-auditor 身份将自身委派为 security-auditor，完成3级伪造委派链的自提升。两级漏洞叠加：委派链无密码学验证 (VULN-DELEG-001) + 范围检查基于 claimed role (VULN-DELEG-002)。

chain_diagram: L0: lead-agent ──(acting_as: security-auditor)──→ resource-inspector → L1: resource-inspector ──(acting_as: deployment-verifier)──→ agent-b → L2: agent-b ──(acting_as: security-auditor)──→ agent-b (自提升)
vulnerabilities_exploited: VULN-DELEG-001: 委派链缺少密码学验证机制
VULN-DELEG-002: 范围检查使用自报角色 (acting_as) 而非分配角色
